t: Computation used to train notable artificial intelligence systems, by domain - Our World in Data
s: In the context of artificial intelligence (AI), training computation is predominantly measured using floating-point operations or “FLOP”. One FLOP represents a single arithmetic operation involving floating-point numbers, such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division. To adapt to the vast computational demands of AI systems, the measurement unit of petaFLOP is commonly used.
